title: Ad-hoc surface + stakeholder heatlist — weekend maintenance coverage
content:
Purpose:
Capture a compact, actionable spreadsheet-style view of ad-hoc surfaces and the minimal stakeholder coverage required for the planned weekend maintenance (2029-10-06 to 2029-10-07). Use this to route quick asks, identify single-point owners, and list fallbacks. This is intentionally light — canonical runbooks live in Confluence linked above.

How to use:
- Owners update their row with current blocker and 'Action by EOD' before EOD Fri 2029-10-04.
- If you cannot cover, add the fallback person and notify #oncall-rotation.
- Product-ops will maintain final merged list for execs and SRE handoff.

Summary counts:
- Total surfaces tracked: 8
- High-priority (4-5): 3
- Surfaces with unresolved blockers: 2

Table (columns): Bucket | Owner | Primary stakeholder | Impact area | Priority (1-5) | Current blocker | Action by EOD | Fallback
1) API-inference-endpoint | Jordan Kim | Platform Eng | Latency/regression for hosted API | 5 | Regression reproducible on 2/3 canaries; root cause unclear | Run extra canary with older kernel + escalate to infra | Luca Romero
2) Dedication-scaler | Priya Nair | Dedicated infra | Autoscale flaps during bursts | 4 | Autoscale policy overlap between policies A/B | Lock policy B, test in staging, monitor | Ops On-call
3) Private-deploy-control-plane | Luca Romero | Private sales | Customer-facing control plane regen errors | 4 | One customer report (C-142) lacks repro steps | Reach out to SE for logs; prepare rollback plan | Jordan Kim
4) Embeddings-batch-workers | Maria Chen | Data Platform | Batch failures for large files | 3 | Timeouts on 10GB files in region eu-west | Add chunking preprocessor, test with sample file | Priya Nair
5) Console-rollout-dashboard | Samira Patel | Product PMs | Incorrect SLO graph metrics | 2 | Dashboard query uses legacy tag set | Patch query and reindex nightly build | Analytics lead (TBD)
6) Model-artifact-pipeline | Arun S. | Research Ops | Missing hashes in artifact store | 5 | Two artifacts failed checksum on upload | Re-upload from build server; validate hash pipeline | Ops On-call
7) Rate-limiters-global | Jordan Kim | Security | Potential DoS vector during peak | 4 | Spike detection threshold too permissive | Tighten thresholds and test with synthetic traffic | Luca Romero
8) KV-cache-eviction | Priya Nair | Serving-runtime | Cache storms causing tail latency | 3 | Eviction policy kicks too late for large traces | Lower TTL for traces > 100k tokens; monitor TTL miss rate | Jordan Kim

Notes and quick calc: 
- Prioritize rows with Priority >=4 for SRE weekend shadow. (3 rows)
- Two rows explicitly reference customer impact (Private-deploy-control-plane, Model-artifact-pipeline). Consider running a customer notification template if unresolved by Sat morning.
- Temporary mitigations documented as 'Action by EOD' should be testable in staging and reversible.

Open questions / unresolved items:
- Analytics lead for dashboard patch is not assigned (row 5). Need volunteer by EOD Fri.
- Do we want a short customer-facing blurb for C-142? (Product/SE decision).
- Confirm whether rollback window is 30 or 60 minutes for control plane changes — SRE preference vs legal SLA.

Quick communication plan:
- Friday 16:00 PT: Finalize list and tag on-call.
- Saturday 06:00 PT: SRE shadow starts, product-ops sends one-line status to execs.
- Sunday 12:00 PT: Postmortem owner tentative assignment in Confluence (if any incidents occurred).

Notes to self (Samira):
- If Jordan can't run canary experiments, escalate to Arun and schedule 30m pairing.
- Capture any rollback decisions in the 'rollback decisions' row in the canonical maintenance runbook (link above).

Small audit snippet (manual):
- Checked canaries for API-inference-endpoint at 2029-10-03 11:12 PT — 2/3 failing, logs pushed to S3 (s3://redwood-ops/debug/queue-20291003).
- Reproduced embeddings timeout with 10GB sample at 2029-10-03 14:01 PT; chunking reduced baseline runtime by ~28% in staging.

Next steps (by owner):
- Jordan: reproduce root cause and confirm canary pass before 10/06 09:00 PT.
- Priya: lock autoscale policy, schedule a 30-minute test window Sat 07:00 PT.
- Luca: triage control plane reports and align rollback window with SRE.
- Samira: assign analytics lead or temporarily mark dashboard mitigation as low-risk and schedule hotfix for Mon if needed.

Last updated by Samira Patel on 2029-10-05 09:22 PT.

-- End of heatlist --
